description: Defines the WebSocketFrameParser class for parsing WebSocket frames from byte streams, including methods for decoding frames, handling errors, and managing frame headers and payloads.

classes.name: WebSocketFrameParser
classes.description: A class for parsing WebSocket frames from byte streams, handling decoding, errors, and frame management.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a byte stream into WebSocket frames, storing results in provided frame_chunks vector.

methods.name: websocket_error
methods.description: Returns the current WebSocket error status.

methods.name: DecodeFrameHeader
methods.description: Attempts to decode a frame header from the given data span.

methods.name: DecodeFramePayload
methods.description: Decodes frame payload and creates a WebSocketFrameChunk object.
